entities.summary: Valentin Yuryevich Katasonov is a Russian scientist-economist, Doctor of Economics. He is associated with the Strategic Culture Foundation (SCF). Valentin Katasonov was a performers & entertainers from Soviet Union (b. 1950-04-05, Soviet Union). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics. Its legacy: Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
